characterization_methods.key_findings: Thin carbides were found in the Fe-17%Al monocrystal with 70 ppm C after a heat treatment of 14 days at 320 °C with concurrent 100 MPa loading in <111> direction; observation of precipitates by metallography is described for the alloys studied.
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: specimens etched by an alcoholic 10% nitric acid solution

characterization_methods.key_findings: Rare globular AlN inclusions with diameters up to 30 µm were identified by EDX analysis in the monocrystals.
characterization_methods.technique: energy-dispersive X-ray analysis (EDX) in scanning electron microscopy (SEM)

processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Monocrystals with up to 10 cm length were grown by the Bridgman method; the crystal growth with subsequent cooling occurred within a time period of about 12 h. Applies to the Fe-17%Al monocrystal of this sample.

processing_steps.method: heat treatment (annealing) of 14 days at 320 °C with concurrent 100 MPa loading in <111> direction
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Applied specifically to the Fe-17%Al monocrystal with 70 ppm C; thin carbides were found after this loaded treatment, whereas without loading much less carbides were observed. Atmosphere for the loaded treatment is not explicitly stated (general non-Argon heat treatments were enclosed in evacuated SiO2 capsules at 10^-6 bar).

aliases: Fe-17%Al monocrystal with 70 ppm C after 14 days at 320 °C with 100 MPa loading

inclusions: rare globular AlN inclusions with diameters up to 30 µm, identified by EDX analysis (observed in the monocrystals)

precipitates.distribution: found in the Fe-17%Al monocrystal with 70 ppm C after a heat treatment of 14 days at 320 °C with concurrent 100 MPa loading in <111> direction; without loading much less carbides were observed. The thin carbides were observed only on grain boundaries in the polycrystals.

structures.overall_structure: Fe-17%Al monocrystal (single crystal) with a bcc Fe-Al matrix in which thin carbides precipitated after the 320 °C/14 d + 100 MPa loaded heat treatment and which contains rare globular AlN inclusions.

unmapped_findings: Composition of the Fe-17%Al monocrystal (Table 1, nominal 17 at.% Al): real Al 16.8 at.% (8.9 wt.-%), C 70 wt.ppm, Si 140 wt.ppm, Cu 50 wt.ppm, Mo 90 wt.ppm.

The thin carbides observed in the Fe-17%Al monocrystal with 70 ppm C after 14 days at 320 °C with concurrent 100 MPa loading in <111> direction were much less abundant when the same heat treatment was carried out without loading (benchmark: unloaded 320 °C/14 d treatment).
Without heat treatment no carbides were found in all monocrystals.

No mechanical property measurements (hardness, compressive/tensile stress-strain) are reported in the paper specifically for the Fe-17%Al monocrystal; the hardness (Fig. 1) and compressive stress-strain (Fig. 2) data refer to (111)- and [112]-oriented Fe-16%Al monocrystals.
